 How to watch, listen to No. 20 Alabama basketball vs. Oakland
 Blake Byler @ blakebyler45 11/09/26 2 Share Share 
 Alabama basketball will be back in action tomorrow night after another quick turnaround, with just three days between Friday night’s win and Monday night’s upcoming contest. The Crimson Tide is set to take on Oakland inside Coleman Coliseum for its third straight home game to open the season.
 The Golden Grizzlies come from the Horizon League and are led by head coach Greg Kampe , in his 43rd season as the head of the program. He’s responsible for all four of the program’s NCAA Tournament appearances, including its most recent in 2024, when it knocked off 3-seed Kentucky to advance to the second round.
 Oakland came into the 2026-27 season picked to finish fourth in the Horizon League, coming off a 16-16 (12-8) season last year. The Golden Grizzlies are off to a slow start this season, already sitting at 0-3 with losses to Michigan, Stanford and UC Santa Barbara, all away from home.
 Alabama is looking to win its third straight game to start the season and will get some major reinforcements in the process. All-SEC guard Aden Holloway is set to return to the lineup for the Crimson Tide after his 5-game suspension during the preseason and beginning of the regular-season has been lifted.
 Tipoff between Alabama and Oakland is set for 6:30 p.m. CT and will be streamed on SEC Network+.
